title: Correcting a Keyturn Vehicle Listing Whose Price Stands above Its Band
content:
Where a fresh valuation moves the band a listing is read against, the price is not brought to the nearer boundary of the new band and left there: it is carried forward, taken through the share of the band the vehicle's cover standing leaves open, held to the movement the day allows, and only then brought inside the band.

Which figure a Keyturn Vehicle Listing carries forward turns on whether the price asked stands above the ceiling of the band, and on how long it is since the vehicle's last completed inspection.

1. Where the price asked stands above the ceiling of the band and the vehicle's last completed inspection is more than 270 calendar days before the handling date, the price is brought to the floor of the band before the movement rule is applied.

2. Where the price asked stands above the ceiling of the band and that inspection is within 270 calendar days, the price is brought to the ceiling of the band.

3. Otherwise the price asked is carried forward as it stands.

### Points of judgement

*A price at or below the ceiling.* Neither of the first two clauses is reached, and the price asked is carried forward as it stands, whatever the age of the last completed inspection.

*At the day boundary.* An inspection dated exactly 270 calendar days before the handling date is within 270 calendar days, so a price above the ceiling is brought to the ceiling; an inspection dated 271 calendar days before it puts the same price to the floor.

*Worked on a hypothetical band.* A price asked of 400.00 USD against a band running from 75.00 USD to 320.00 USD: with the last completed inspection 300 calendar days back, the figure carried forward is 75.00 USD; with it 100 calendar days back, the figure carried forward is 320.00 USD.
